Repair the buggy source below without changing the required API.

File contract: Return CommonJS module solution.js.
Required API: exports.clampedSlice = function(text, start, end)
Behavior: For a string and signed start/end offsets, translate negative offsets from the string length, clamp both to [0,length], and return the half-open substring. If the clamped start exceeds the clamped end, return the empty string. Operate on Unicode scalar/code-point units, not bytes.
Visible example: clampedSlice('abcd', -3, 9) returns 'bcd', while (3,1) returns ''.

Buggy source to repair:

exports.clampedSlice=()=>null;
